author: yorickdowne
content:
So I have an answer without creating a fresh survey. For bandwidth, see the survey results linked at https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1570846883927167077/1570938197297602633

For AVX-512, after digging a little bit, that instruction set was all but abandoned on consumer CPUs. Even a Xeon E-2288G, which is an entry-level server CPU you'll find in baremetal servers, doesn't have it. On the consumer side, all the NUC stuff, Intel 11th gen was the last to support it, in 2021. They want to bring it back with AVX10 in future (starting with the CPUs to be released late 2026 / into 2027), but that doesn't help you any now

author: yorickdowne
content: AMD have it in Ryzen Zen 4/5, but that's going to be the minority of machines, as will be 2021 and older Intel

author: yorickdowne
content: Be happy if you encounter it, but only count on, and test with, AVX2
